answer: Vesting with clawback: every reward vests linearly over 30 epochs, and any identity later linked to a flagged cluster forfeits all unvested rewards to a shared pool. A farm of 100 fake keys must keep 30 epochs of earnings exposed at once, so each added identity ties up more capital, like a river that must keep flowing to reach its canyon. Flags come from public audits of funding links and co-attestation, and anyone can recompute vesting balances from chain history. Honest users collect their nectar steadily, while farms lose a growing share.
